decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has a proven government customer base and connects to over 30 APIS schemes, making it a core, revenue-generating offer.
Demand for travel health requirements has declined after the pandemic, but the API has its own page and complements the firm's document verification and airline services.
A cyber security awareness module is cheap to maintain, fits the firm's certified training business and sells into a growing compliance market.
Behaviour analysis builds on the firm's specialist aviation security expertise and supports its strategy of integrating technology with personnel.
Passenger profiling is a long-standing aviation security competence of the firm and is embedded in its services to airports and airlines.
The travel and document verification platform is close to the firm's established offer, has its own page and serves continuing airline compliance needs.
